messages:
Maria_fin: Quick heads up — customer 'HelioMaps' flagged an unexpected Dedicated charge on invoice INV-2025-045 for 2025-05. Shows 120 GPU-hours in EU reserved pool + a separate 28 GPU-hour 'burst' on same days. They claim they had reserved capacity and only failed over for <1 hour. Can we reconcile? I've attached the usage CSV.

billing_bot: Uploaded invoice and meter export: /files/INV-2025-045.csv

billing_bot: CSV snippet:
```
date,region,pool_type,hours,charge
2025-05-09,eu-central-1,reserved,120,240.00
2025-05-09,eu-west-2,burst,28,84.00
```

ken_prod: Looking into this. We had a hot-restart on the EU routing proxy and some requests were routed to eu-west-2 while the reserved pool lived in eu-central-1. There's a short window where the allocation copy duplicated meters. PR #5421 fixed the metric de-dupe.

ken_prod: Quick query we ran:
```
SELECT meter_id, SUM(hours) FROM billing_events
WHERE customer='heliomaps' AND date='2025-05-09'
GROUP BY meter_id;
```

oliver_ops: Can finance confirm whether those 28 hours were paid as burst in addition to being counted against the reserved commit? If so we should issue a credit. cc @sasha_sales for customer comms :eyes:

sasha_sales: I'll prepare a comms draft. Need final credit amount to include in the email.

Maria_fin: From invoice math: reserved commit billed 120h * $2/h = $240; extra 28h burst billed at $3/h = $84. If the 28h were part of the reserved pool and were double-counted, credit should be $84. No SLA breach reported by monitoring for that customer.

ken_prod: Confirmed: those 28h were real work but were recorded to both meters due to the hot-restart. Recommend crediting the burst line and re-running the billing job for 2025-05-09 to de-dupe records. Action: create credit memo CM-2025-078.

oliver_ops: Opened internal ticket TKT-9876 to re-run billing and lock the billing window. ETA 48h. Will update here when job finishes. :white_check_mark:

billing_bot: Created credit memo CM-2025-078 for $84.00 — status: pending_approval

Maria_fin: Approving conditional on ops completing the rerun and confirming the duplicate rows are removed. @diana_finlead can you sign off on the approval?

diana_finlead: Approved. Please post the credit and cc customer@heliomaps.com once CM posts. Add note to INV-2025-045: "Issued credit CM-2025-078 for duplicate burst meters during failover."

sasha_sales: Draft to customer:
"Hi HelioMaps team — we've identified a duplicate burst charge on INV-2025-045 caused by a short failover window. We've issued a $84 credit (CM-2025-078) and fixed the underlying routing bug. We'll email again once the credit posts. As an apology we've applied a 10% discount on next month's burst usage (one-time)."

Maria_fin: Thanks all — closing once CM posts and billing job completes. Keep me posted.
